population: Iranian community-dwelling older adults, Birjand Longitudinal Aging Study, n=227, aged 60-90
conclusion: The paper's primary test, association with frailty, was null (allelic p = 0.36; fully adjusted OR 0.96, 95% CI 0.10-9.66). No odds ratio is reported for that trend test, so none is recorded.

population: Finnish men: 43 long-lived healthy vs 92 controls (Helsinki Birth Cohort Study), replicated in 63 healthy men of mean age 83 (Helsinki Businessmen Study); n=198 combined
conclusion: Combined two-tailed Fisher exact test over both Finnish cohorts (Table 2): the T allele is depleted among the long-lived. The authors' own power analysis puts the study at 28.4% power. The abstract states OR 3.53 / p 0.07 for this same test while Table 2 states OR 3.58 / p 0.074; the table values are what is recorded here. This paper's Table 1 types the variant as an intron variant.
